message: x-enum-varnames entry "1_TILDE" for enum value "~" is not suitable for code generation. It must start with a letter and only contain letters, numbers, and underscores. Fern ignores it and cannot generate a name from the value either.

x-fern-enum name "_at" for enum value "@@" is not suitable for code generation. It must start with a letter and only contain letters, numbers, and underscores. Fern ignores it and cannot generate a name from the value either.

x-fern-enum name "2gte" for enum value ">=" is not suitable for code generation. It must start with a letter and only contain letters, numbers, and underscores. Fern ignores it and uses the name it generates from the value, "GREATER_THAN_OR_EQUAL_TO".
